title: Fix AITDK poison-pill infinite loop, reduce batch size to 5, and mark unindexed domains as tried
summary: 1) Return queriedDomains in TrafficResult so callers know all domains requested; 2) In shopify-bw.service.ts and afflib.service.ts, mark all queried domains in traffic_tried_at regardless of whether AITDK had traffic data or 0 visits/unindexed, stopping the permanent queue-head blocker loop; 3) Remove destructive doEnsureTables query resetting traffic_tried_at to NULL; 4) Normalize trailing slashes on domain lookup and markTrafficTried; 5) Reduce AITDK BATCH_SIZE from 10 to 5 for fast 1.5-2.5s response times, set DIRECT_TIMEOUT_MS to 30s to eliminate aborts, and single domain timeout to 8s.
